quests.instruction: Which family member is the mother of one of your four grandparents?
quests.question: Great-Grandmother
quests.hint: She is three generations above you.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandmother is the mother of one of your four grandparents.
quests.funFact: Since you can have up to four grandparents, you can also have up to four great-grandmothers!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy whose parent is your own sibling?
quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: His mom or dad is your own brother or sister.
quests.explanation: Nephew is a boy whose parent is your own sibling.
quests.funFact: A nephew and his own cousins share a grandparent, just like you and your cousins do!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy sibling who is the very same age as you, down to the day?
quests.question: Twin Brother
quests.hint: There is zero difference in age between the two of you.
quests.explanation: Twin Brother is a boy sibling who is the very same age as you, down to the day.
quests.funFact: Twins usually celebrate their birthdays together every single year!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl, one generation below you, connected to you through your sibling?
quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: Her parent shares your own mom and dad.
quests.explanation: Niece is a girl, one generation below you, connected through your sibling.
quests.funFact: A niece is part of your extended family, even though she may not live in your own home!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your sister, but with zero age difference between the two of you?
quests.question: Twin Sister
quests.hint: This sister is exactly your age, not older or younger.
quests.explanation: Twin Sister is your sister, but with zero age difference between the two of you.
quests.funFact: Growing up as a twin often means always having a built-in playmate close by!

quests.instruction: Which family member is one generation above your grandparents, and is a woman?
quests.question: Great-Grandmother
quests.hint: Think three whole generations above you.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandmother is one generation above your grandparents, and is a woman.
quests.funFact: Not everyone gets to meet a great-grandmother, so it can be an extra special connection!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy who is not your own child, but is closely related through your sibling?
quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: His parent is your brother or your sister.
quests.explanation: Nephew is a boy who is not your own child, but is closely related to you through your sibling.
quests.funFact: Many aunts and uncles say watching a nephew grow up is one of family life's greatest joys!

quests.instruction: Which family member entered the world together with you on your one shared birthday, and is a boy?
quests.question: Twin Brother
quests.hint: This brother's birth story is the same day as your own.
quests.explanation: Twin Brother entered the world together with you on your shared birthday.
quests.funFact: Twins often love celebrating a joint birthday party together with friends and family!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl whose grandparent is also your own parent?
quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: She is the daughter of your brother or sister.
quests.explanation: Niece is a girl whose grandparent is also your own parent, since her parent is your sibling.
quests.funFact: Your own parents become grandparents to your nieces and nephews, if you have siblings with children!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl sibling who was born just moments before or after you, on the same day?
quests.question: Twin Sister
quests.hint: She was born within minutes of you, on your very own birthday.
quests.explanation: Twin Sister is a girl sibling who was born just moments before or after you, on the same day.
quests.funFact: The very first twin born is sometimes jokingly called the 'older' twin, even if only by a few minutes!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the grandmother of your own mother or father?
quests.question: Great-Grandmother
quests.hint: She is two generations above your own parent.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandmother is the grandmother of your own mother or father.
quests.funFact: Your parent had their own grandmother growing up, just like you have yours!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your sister's son or your brother's son?
quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: He is the boy child of one of your siblings.
quests.explanation: Nephew is your sister's son or your brother's son.
quests.funFact: The word 'nephew' comes from an old word related to 'grandson', though today it means a sibling's son!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a brother who celebrates a birthday on the exact same date as yours, every year?
quests.question: Twin Brother
quests.hint: This is not simply a brother close in age — the date matches exactly.
quests.explanation: Twin Brother celebrates a birthday on the exact same date as yours, every single year.
quests.funFact: Even twins can have different personalities and interests, even though they share a birthday!

quests.instruction: Which family member might one day call you 'Aunt' or 'Uncle'?
quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: She is your sibling's own daughter.
quests.explanation: Niece might call you 'Aunt' or 'Uncle', since she is your sibling's daughter.
quests.funFact: Being called 'Aunt' or 'Uncle' by a niece is a special title many people are proud of!

quests.instruction: Which family member was born at nearly the same moment as you, from the very same pregnancy, and is a girl?
quests.question: Twin Sister
quests.hint: You and this sister grew together before either of you were born.
quests.explanation: Twin Sister was born at nearly the same moment as you, from the same pregnancy.
quests.funFact: Doctors can often tell parents ahead of time if they are expecting twins!

quests.instruction: Whose grandchildren became your own grandparents?
quests.question: Great-Grandmother
quests.hint: Think of the woman three generations above you.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandmother's grandchildren became your own grandparents.
quests.funFact: This kind of family puzzle is a fun way to practice understanding generations!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy, one generation below you, connected to you through your sibling?
quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: His parent shares your own mom and dad.
quests.explanation: Nephew is a boy, one generation below you, connected through your sibling.
quests.funFact: A nephew is part of your extended family, even though he may not live in your own home!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a brother who was born on the exact same day as you?
quests.question: Twin Brother
quests.hint: This brother shares your very own birthday, not just your parents.
quests.explanation: Twin Brother is a brother who was born on the exact same day as you.
quests.funFact: Twins are born from the same pregnancy, just moments apart from each other!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl whose parent is your own sibling?
quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: Her mom or dad is your own brother or sister.
quests.explanation: Niece is a girl whose parent is your own sibling.
quests.funFact: A niece and her own cousins share a grandparent, just like you and your cousins do!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a sister who was born on the exact same day as you?
quests.question: Twin Sister
quests.hint: This sister shares your very own birthday, not just your parents.
quests.explanation: Twin Sister is a sister who was born on the exact same day as you.
quests.funFact: The word 'twin' comes from an old word meaning 'two together'!

quests.instruction: Which family member is three generations above you on a family tree, and is a woman?
quests.question: Great-Grandmother
quests.hint: Count up: parent, grandparent, then one more generation.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandmother is three generations above you on a family tree, and is a woman.
quests.funFact: Family trees can stretch back many generations, with each new branch showing an earlier relative!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the male child of your brother or your sister?
quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: He calls your sibling 'Mom' or 'Dad'.
quests.explanation: Nephew is the male child of your brother or your sister.
quests.funFact: Aunts and uncles often love spoiling a nephew with extra treats and fun outings!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy sibling who was born just moments before or after you, on the same day?
quests.question: Twin Brother
quests.hint: He was born within minutes of you, on your very own birthday.
quests.explanation: Twin Brother is a boy sibling who was born just moments before or after you, on the same day.
quests.funFact: In a set of twins, one baby is usually born just a few minutes before the other!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your sister's daughter or your brother's daughter?
quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: She is the girl child of one of your siblings.
quests.explanation: Niece is your sister's daughter or your brother's daughter.
quests.funFact: The word 'niece' comes from an old word meaning granddaughter, though today it means a sibling's daughter!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl sibling who is the very same age as you, down to the day?
quests.question: Twin Sister
quests.hint: Count the years and days between your ages — this sister's total is exactly zero.
quests.explanation: Twin Sister is a girl sibling who is the very same age as you, down to the day.
quests.funFact: Many twins enjoy being in the same class together at school as they grow up!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the mother of your grandmother or your grandfather?
quests.question: Great-Grandmother
quests.hint: She belongs to a generation even older than your grandparents.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandmother is the mother of your grandmother or your grandfather.
quests.funFact: Meeting a great-grandmother lets you hear stories from even further back in your family's history!

quests.instruction: Thinking further ahead, whose future children would call you their great-aunt or great-uncle?
quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: Think of your sibling's son.
quests.explanation: Nephew's own children would grow up to be your grand-nieces or grand-nephews one day.
quests.funFact: Family trees can keep branching for many generations, adding new titles like grand-nephew!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your brother, but with zero age difference between the two of you?
quests.question: Twin Brother
quests.hint: This brother is exactly your age, not older or younger.
quests.explanation: Twin Brother is your brother, but with zero age difference between the two of you.
quests.funFact: Being a twin means always having a sibling exactly your own age to grow up alongside!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the female child of your brother or your sister?
quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: She calls your sibling 'Mom' or 'Dad'.
quests.explanation: Niece is the female child of your brother or your sister.
quests.funFact: Aunts and uncles often love spoiling a niece with extra treats and fun outings!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl born from the very same pregnancy as you?
quests.question: Twin Sister
quests.hint: She grew alongside you before either of you were born.
quests.explanation: Twin Sister is a girl born from the very same pregnancy as you.
quests.funFact: Twins are considered quite rare, making up only a small percentage of all births!
